description: Defines classes and templates for managing CUDA sparse matrix descriptors in PyTorch, including creation, deletion, and configuration of sparse matrix descriptors for CUDA operations.

classes.name: CuSparseDescriptor
classes.description: Template class managing CUDA sparse descriptors with automatic resource management.

classes.name: ConstCuSparseDescriptor
classes.description: Template class for constant CUDA sparse descriptors with automatic resource management.

classes.name: CuSparseMatDescriptor
classes.description: Manages CUDA sparse matrix descriptor with optional fill mode and diagonal type.

classes.name: CuSparseBsrsv2Info
classes.description: Encapsulates BSR sparse matrix solver info for CUDA.

classes.name: CuSparseBsrsm2Info
classes.description: Encapsulates BSR sparse matrix multiplication info for CUDA.

classes.name: CuSparseDnMatDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for dense CUDA sparse matrix.

classes.name: CuSparseConstDnMatDescriptor
classes.description: Constant descriptor for dense CUDA sparse matrix.

classes.name: CuSparseDnVecDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for dense CUDA sparse vector.

classes.name: CuSparseSpMatCsrDescriptor
classes.description: CSR format sparse matrix descriptor with size and tensor setup methods.

methods.name: descriptor
methods.description: Returns the raw CUDA descriptor pointer.

methods.name: get_size
methods.description: Retrieves size (rows, cols, nnz) of the sparse matrix.

methods.name: set_tensor
methods.description: Sets CSR pointers from tensor data.

methods.name: set_mat_fill_mode
methods.description: Sets fill mode (upper/lower) for sparse matrix.

methods.name: set_mat_diag_type
methods.description: Sets diagonal type (unit/non-unit) for sparse matrix.
